pass_a_gloss: But since some, not observing the account about the demons, and how, for the sake of staying on in this thick and around-the-earth air, needing the food that comes through the exhalations, they watch for where there are always savours of fat and bloods and frankincense, cheapen the sacrificing as a thing indifferent, we would say also toward these things that, if those providing food to bandits and killers and barbarian foes of the great king are also chastised as having wronged the public good, by how much more would those who through the sacrificing give to the underlings of the badness foods holding them back in the around-the-earth place most justly be charged, and above all if, having learned the saying: the one sacrificing to other gods will be utterly destroyed, except to the Lord only, they should sacrifice to the ones responsible for the bad things on earth. And I suppose indeed that, upon the things sinned by the demons working against the humans, they will be charged not less than the demons who worked the worse things, having nourished them through the sacrificing; for as if in common the bad things have been made for the humans both by the demons and by those who held them down on earth, since they would not have been able to hold out apart from the exhalations and the foods thought to be fitting to their bodies.
pass_b_english: Some people do not consider the teaching about the demons: that, in order to stay in this thick air around the earth, they need the nourishment that comes from fumes, and so they keep watch wherever there is always the smell of burnt fat, and blood, and incense. Since these people make light of sacrificing as a matter of indifference, we would say this to them as well. If those who supply food to robbers and murderers and to barbarian enemies of the great king are punished as men who have wronged the commonwealth, how much more justly would those be charged who by sacrificing give food to the servants of wickedness, food that keeps them in the region around the earth; and above all if, having learned the words, “He who sacrifices to other gods shall be utterly destroyed, except to the Lord alone” (Exodus 22:20), they should sacrifice to the causes of the evils on earth.

And I think that for the sins committed by the demons as they work against human beings, those who fed them by sacrificing will be charged no less than the demons who did the evil work. For the demons and those who kept them on earth have, as it were, done the evils to human beings together, since the demons could not have lasted without the fumes and what are thought to be the foods suited to their bodies.

choices.choice: 2026-11-11: retranslated in full from Koetschau (GCS 2, ch. 45); the old English was a digest: it invented 'the earthly intent of the hostile power's assault', 'idols are nothing' and 'lest they boast to have overcome God's soldiers', and inserted 1 Corinthians 10:20, which Origen does not quote here; it dropped the analogy of feeding the emperor's enemies.
'xal αἷς' read as 'καὶ ὡς' ('and how'); '0x xviooa' as 'ὅπη κνῖσαι' (Koetschau's apparatus: ὅπη M); 'ἀέρε' as 'ἀέρι'; 'Oo θύων' as 'ὁ θύων'.
The opening 'Since some ..., we would say' is one Greek period; it is split into shorter sentences while keeping 'Since' and every clause.

source_text: Ἐπεὶ δέ τινες μὴ ϑεωροῦντες. τὸν περὶ τῶν δαιμόνων λόγον, xal αἷς ὑπὲρ τοῦ παραμένειν ἐν τῷ παχεῖ τούτῳ καὶ περιγείῳ ἀέρε δεόμενοι τροφῆς τῆς διὰ τῶν ἀναϑυμιάσεων ἐπιτηροῦσιν 0x xviooa ἀεὶ καὶ αἵματα καὶ λιβανωτοὶ, ἐξευτελίζουσιν ὡς ἀδιάφορον τὸ ϑύειν, εἴποιμεν ἂν καὶ πρὸς ταῦτα ὅτι, εἴπερ οἱ τροφὰς λῃσταῖς καὶ φονεῦσι καὶ βαρβάροις ἐχϑροῖς τοῦ μεγάλου βασιλέως παρέχοντες ὡς τὸ κοινὸν ἀδικήσαντες καὶ κολάζονται, πόσῳ πλέον οἱ τοῖς τῆς κακίας ὑπηρέταις διὰ τοῦ ϑύειν διδόντες τροφὰς παρακατεχούσας αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ περιγείῳ τόπῳ δικαιότατα ἂν ἐγχαλοῖντο, καὶ μάλιστα εἰ μαϑόντες τό" „Oo ϑύων ϑεοῖς ἑτέροις ἐξολοϑρευϑήσεται, πλὴν κυρίῳ μόνῳ", ϑύοιεν τοῖς τῶν ἐπὶ γῆς καχῶν αἰτίοις. καὶ οἶμαί γε ἐπὶ τοῖς; ἁμαρτανομένοις ὑπὸ τῶν δαιμόνων ἐνεργούντων κατὰ τῶν ἀνϑρώπῶν οὐχ ἔλαττον ἐγχληϑήσεσϑαι τῶν ἐνεργησάντων δαιμόνων τὰ χείρονα, διὰ τοῦ ϑύειν ϑρέψαντες αὐτούς" οἱονεὶ γὰρ κοινῇ τὰ κακὰ πεποιήχασι τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οἵ τε δαίμονες xal οἱ κατασχόντες αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ γῆς, μὴ ἂν δυνηϑέντας διαρχέσαι χωρὶς τῶν ἀναϑυμιάσεῶν καὶ τῶν νομιζομένων εἶναι χαταλλήλων τροφῶν τοῖς σώμασιν αὐτῶν.
